answer_facts: Admission to Undergraduate programmes in the constituent and affiliated colleges of Cluster University of Srinagar is done through the centralised admission website of the J&K Higher Education Department.

The centralised admission for 2026-27 covers Four Year Undergraduate Programs (FYUGP) and 5-Year Integrated P.G. Programs (IG) with multiple-exit options across the degree colleges of Jammu and Kashmir.
Step 1: all aspirants must first register on the centralised admission website https://jkadmissions.in/ and fill in their preferences there.
Step 2: the portal publishes the first merit list (Round 1) of selected candidates.
Step 3: candidates selected in Round 1 complete the admission formalities and pay the fee.
Step 4: the portal publishes the second merit list (Round 2) for the seats still vacant.
Step 5: candidates selected in Round 2 complete the admission formalities and pay the fee.
Step 6: a spot round is held to fill the leftover seats.
Step 7: classwork begins after the admission process is complete.
The exact published dates for each of these stages are given in the published admission schedule for the cycle.
The admission is based on 10+2 merit, and subject offerings differ from college to college and become visible on the portal at the time of preference filling.
Detailed eligibility conditions and the major subjects available in the constituent and affiliated colleges are published on the university website www.cusrinagar.edu.in.

answer_facts: The single portal for UG admission is https://jkadmissions.in/, the centralised admission website of the J&K Higher Education Department.

The notice states that admission to undergraduate programmes shall be done through this centralised admission website, and that candidates are required to apply online at https://jkadmissions.in/ for admission.
Subject offerings differ from college to college and become visible on the admission portal at the time of preference filling.
Eligibility conditions and available major subjects are on the university website www.cusrinagar.edu.in.
Registration needs clear, legible scanned copies in PDF or JPG format, not exceeding 1 MB each.

The documents listed for registration are: Class 12th marks card, recent passport-size photograph(s), Class 10th marks card, Aadhaar number, domicile certificate (if available), and category certificate (if any).
Category certificates that are under process, incomplete or pending with the competent authority are not accepted.
The detailed admission notice and registration manual are published on the official admission website.
A non-refundable registration fee of Rupees 200 (two hundred only) is charged for UG registration on the centralised portal.
The registration fee is separate from any other payment; the notice states it as a registration fee only.
Admissions are offered across more than 60 major subjects in 142 degree colleges in Jammu and Kashmir on the basis of 10+2 merit.
Subject offerings vary from college to college and are visible to aspirants on the admission portal at the time of preference filling.
The university publishes the detailed eligibility conditions and the major subjects available in its constituent and affiliated colleges on www.cusrinagar.edu.in.
Aspirants are advised to visit the counselling and facilitation centres established at all degree colleges of Jammu and Kashmir for form submission and preference filling, to avoid mistakes.
The detailed admission notice and the registration manual are published on the official admission website, https://jkadmissions.in/.
The 2026-27 centralised notice published this schedule: registration and preference filling on one link opens 09 May 2026 at 10.00 AM and closes 27 May 2026 at 7.00 PM.
First merit list (Round 1) 30 May 2026; completion of admission formalities and fee payment for Round 1 candidates 1 to 6 June 2026.
Second merit list (Round 2) 9 June 2026; completion of admission formalities and fee payment for Round 2 candidates 10 to 15 June 2026.
Spot round for leftover seats 18 to 25 June 2026.
Start of classwork: winter zone colleges 15 June 2026 and summer zone colleges 15 July 2026.
These are the dates published in the 2026-27 notice. They are a published schedule, not a live confirmation that admission is currently open or closed.
The 4-Year Undergraduate Design Your Degree (DYD) programme is a separate Cluster University of Srinagar admission route, and admission is based on the academic merit of the 10+2 examination.
Candidates submit the online application form on the university website www.cusrinagar.edu.in; an application form in any other mode is not entertained.
Eligibility is 10+2 pass in any stream or equivalent from a recognised board with 55% marks or more for UR and 50% marks or more for reserved categories.

The programme is a full-time regular course with an intake of 60 seats, 15 for each college: Amar Singh College Srinagar, Abdul Ahad Azad Memorial Degree College Bemina, Sri Pratap College Srinagar, GCW M.A. Road Srinagar, and Institute of Advanced Studies in Education Srinagar.
A non-refundable online application fee of Rs 700 is payable.

The reservation policy is implemented as per S.O. 176 dated 15-03-2024 read with S.O. 305 dated 21-05-2024 of seats in Government colleges, with any later notified amendments; no under-process certificate is accepted.
Selection for reserved categories is strictly on merit and on the validity of the respective reserved-category certificate.
The DYD notification published these dates: online submission of the application form through the website opens on 22 May 2026.
The last date for submission of the online application form along with the fee is 12 June 2026.
The DYD application form is submitted online through the university website, so these dates refer to the online window on www.cusrinagar.edu.in.
These are the dates published in the DYD notification. They are a published schedule, not a live confirmation that the application window is currently open or closed.
PG and integrated programme admission for 2026-27 is through the Cluster University Entrance Test (CLUET-2026-27), for which online applications are invited from eligible candidates.
Step 1: visit the Cluster University of Srinagar website https://www.cusrinagar.edu.in/ and click the Admissions tab.
Step 2: select PG Admissions 2026 and read the important instructions for registration and submission of the application form.
Step 3: after reading the instructions, click New Registration and select the PG/IG programme (1 year, 2 year or 3 year) based on eligibility.
Step 4: click the Apply now tab and fill in all details carefully, including uploading the photograph, preferences and documents.
Step 5: deposit the non-refundable application fee through online mode.
Step 6: view the application details using the username and password and retain the printout of the application form for future reference.
Candidates need not submit a hard copy of the application form or of the fee receipt; they should take a printout of the online submitted application form and fee receipt and retain it.

answer_facts: The PG application fee is non-refundable: Rs 700 for one programme and Rs 300 for each subsequent programme.
The fee is deposited through online mode as part of the online application.
The PG online application requires uploading the photograph, the programme preferences and the supporting documents on the Apply now tab.

The 2026 PG admission notification does not publish a separate itemised list of the documents to be uploaded; the detailed minimum requirements and eligibility criteria are in the Admission Prospectus-2026 on the university website www.cusrinagar.edu.in under the Admissions tab.

Educational and category certificates are not checked or verified at the time of online submission for the written examination; they are verified by the Admission Section of the University or Department at the time of completion of admission formalities for selected candidates.

answer_facts: For a 2-year Master's programme, the qualification is a 3-year or 4-year graduation in any stream or subject combination.
For a 1-year Master's programme, the qualification is a 4-year graduation (honours mode or research mode) having 20 credits in the concerned subject.

Programme-specific eligibility in Annexure I of the notification generally requires a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university with at least 50% marks or the equivalent on the grading scale of the respective university, with 45% for reserved categories, and often a minimum of 12 credits in the concerned or allied subject under NEP-2020/CBCS or the subject studied over six semesters or three years.
Candidates awaiting final year or semester (6th/8th) results may apply provisionally, subject to fulfilment of the eligibility conditions at the time of admission.
The detailed minimum required percentage and eligibility criteria for each programme are published in the Admission Prospectus-2026 on the university website under the Admissions tab.
Admission and selection of a candidate is strictly provisional and subject to verification of documents, made at any point during the admission process.

The Directorate does not check or verify the educational and category certificates at the time of online submission for the written examination; it is the sole responsibility of the candidate to ascertain that the eligibility criteria for the programme applied to are fulfilled.
Documents are verified by the Admission Section of the University or Department at the time of completion of admission-related formalities for selected candidates.
Admission of a selected candidate is rejected at any time if the applicant does not fulfil the eligibility criteria or has misrepresented or concealed any facts or information.

Only candidates who have applied and appeared in the entrance test of the subject concerned are eligible for admission under the self-financed seats category; a separate notification for self-financed seats is issued later.
Submission of the application form and appearance in the entrance test are subject to the Admission Policy-2026.
PG and integrated programme admission for 2026-27 is through the Cluster University Entrance Test, CLUET-2026-27.
Submission of the application form and appearance in the entrance test are subject to the Admission Policy-2026.
The detailed date sheet for the entrance test is uploaded on the university website in due course of time.
The syllabi prescribed for the entrance test are published on the university website under the Admissions tab.
The detailed entrance-test date sheet is not part of the admission notification, so the published date sheet on the university website is the authoritative source for the test schedule.

The 2026 PG admission notification published these dates: online submission of application forms from 20 May 2026, and the last date for submission of online application forms and fee as 10 June 2026.
The notification did not publish dates for the entrance test itself; the detailed entrance-test date sheet is uploaded on the university website in due course of time.
These are the dates published in the 2026 notification. They are a published schedule, not a live confirmation that the application window is currently open or closed.
The official university website is https://www.cusrinagar.edu.in/, and all admission material is published under its Admissions tab.

The Admissions tab carries the Admission Prospectus-2026, the detailed minimum percentage and eligibility criteria, the entrance-test syllabi, the Admission Policy-2026 and the admission notifications.
The detailed admission notice and the registration manual for UG admission are published on the centralised admission website https://jkadmissions.in/.
The verified admission notifications are published as official PDFs under https://www.cusrinagar.edu.in/FolderManager/Notification/.
The admissions email published in the official CUS admission notifications is admissions@cusrinagar.edu.in.
Queries about a PG programme should go to the respective Admission Coordinator listed in the Admission Prospectus-2026 on the university website under the Admissions tab.
The Directorate of Admissions is at Cluster University of Srinagar, Gogji Bagh, Srinagar.
The university must be contacted at the official website www.cusrinagar.edu.in for admission updates.
